rung_purposes.purpose: Initialize ST20 test thresholds and parameters.
Set alarm for PT-2001 sensor fault or wire break.
Set alarm for ST20 pack overpressure.
Set alarm for ST20 supply air low during cycle.
Reset ST20 alarms via PB-0002 fault reset pushbutton.
Aggregate ST20 faults and E-stop loss to general fault and drive HL-2011 beacon.
Manual control of XV-2004 vent valve via PB-2010.
Start ST20 cycle and enter CLAMP step when pallet is present in auto mode without faults.
Transition from CLAMP step to FILL step when ZS-2002A clamp is closed.
Run ST20 fill step timeout timer.
Trigger ST20 fill timeout alarm if fill timer completes.
Transition from FILL to STABILISE step when target pressure is reached.
Run ST20 stabilisation timer.
Capture ST20 test start pressure to D110 upon test window timer completion.
Transition from STABILISE step to TEST step when stabilise timer completes.
Run ST20 test window timer.
Calculate pressure decay upon test window timer completion.
Evaluate PASS or FAIL result based on calculated pressure decay.
Transition from TEST step to VENT step when test window timer completes.
Abort ST20 cycle to VENT step and flag FAIL upon general fault during busy cycle.
Run ST20 vent step minimum time timer.
Transition from VENT to UNCLAMP step when timer completes and pressure drops below safe threshold.
Transition from UNCLAMP step to COMPLETE step when ZS-2002B clamp is fully open.
End ST20 cycle and clear busy flag when pallet leaves the test position.
Drive XY-2002 clamp close solenoid during active cycle steps.
Drive XV-2003 fill valve during FILL step if no fault is active.
Drive XV-2004 vent valve during VENT step or upon overpressure alarm.
Output ST20 PASS or FAIL results to the line controller.
End of ST20 program.
